_note: Tracked, server-lane seed registry for drawing.write tools (M2). deps.all_tools() folds these in additively so /api/run resolves them by name. Read tools stay in engine/registry.json; authored tools stay in the gitignored authored_tools.json.

tools.name: delete-marked-panel
tools.description: Deletes one marked panel polyline (by handle; default = first on layer Panels) and adds a marker entity — produces a new immutable drawing version.

drawing_id.description: Target drawing in the versioned store (well-known demo id at APS_LIVE=0).

handle.description: Handle of the polyline to delete; default = first polyline on `layer`.

layer.description: Layer to pick the default deletion target from.
